en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I thought we had just come a little closer
to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>But we're still struggling.
Wandering in the darkness.

<CLT=cltMIND>is fueling this killing game.
Just like Kokichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder how Tenko would have
dealt with Kokichi right now...

<CLT=cltMIND>You were so troublesome,
even at the very end.

<CLT=cltMIND>But still...you didn't have to die.
You didn't deserve to die like that, Miu...

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item on the stone statue,
a building rose up...

<CLT=cltMIND>When I placed the stone on the pedestal,
a building flew over here...

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?
Perhaps I shouldn't even think about it.
<CLT=cltMIND>So this was the key after all...
